Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood follow-up: pilot credits / commit tiers

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. Nimbus is interested in validating Redwood for two product lines that are sensitive to latency and cost. Before we engage procurement, can you outline how Redwood typically handles:

- Sponsored pilot credits for a 4–6 week POC — do you provide a fixed credit pool or percentage of committed spend?
- Per-token tiered discounts if we commit to a flat monthly token spend (example: target ~1M tokens/month for 12 months).
- Any restrictions on using credits for embeddings vs generation, and whether credits expire or roll forward.

High level constraints from our side: finance prefers net30 PO-based deals; legal requests a short MPA with data-processing terms. We also have a question on a launch-incentive structure — is there a standard way Redwood ties promo credits to an initial commit?

If you can put a short proposal together (pricing bands + one recommended promo structure), procurement will be able to compare formally. We aim to kick off the trial in early June.

Thanks — Olivia
Olivia Park
Head of Product
Nimbus Security

Team — forwarding Nimbus' ask. TL;DR: target is ~1M tokens/mo x 12, wants a pilot and clarity on per-token banded discounts and how to structure launch credits. They want an official proposal for procurement by next week.

Notes / ask:
- Can Legal/Finance approve a pilot credit structure tied to a signed MPA and a PO?
- What discount bands can Sales commit to without exec approval?
- I'd like to offer a promotional credit tied to a 3-month minimum commit; details below are my draft.

Draft option (for discussion):
1) Pilot: 75k free-generation tokens valid for 45 days after MPA signature; can be used for embeddings + generation (counts against same token pool). Credits are non-transferrable and expire.
2) Commit tiers (month average):
   - Tier A: 0–1M tokens/month — $0.00060/token (list)
   - Tier B: >1M–5M tokens/month — $0.00045/token (25% discount)
   - Tier C: >5M tokens/month — $0.00035/token (42% discount)
   Pricing would be usage-based with monthly invoicing and net30.
3) Launch incentive: one-time bonus credit equal to 10% of the first quarter committed spend (applied after first invoice), unlocked after PO and first invoice paid.

I propose Finance approves up to 25% discount at Tier B without exec sign-off; anything deeper requires pricing director OK. Markus — can you confirm ranges and legal language for credit expiry and PO requirement? Ben — any notes on how Sales should present footprints/usage estimate to maximize chance of a pilot -> committed deal?

Thanks,
Steph

Steph — good framing. A few changes and approvals from Finance/Legal:

Pricing/discounts (approved ranges):
- Baseline list: $0.00060/token (generation), $0.00030/token (embeddings) — note: embeddings billed separately at 50% of generation list.
- Band discounts (by committed average monthly tokens):
  * Tier A (0–1M): List price;
  * Tier B (1M–5M): 20–30% discount range — we can commit to 25% in most cases (i.e., $0.00045/gen);
  * Tier C (>5M): 35–45% discount range; we can approve 40% (i.e., $0.00036/gen) with a 12-month commit.

Pilot & credits (Legal/Finance notes):
- We can offer a sponsored pilot credit equal to either a fixed token pool or a spend-based credit. Recommend spend-based for larger deals: pilot credit = min($5k, 5% of first-quarter committed spend). For Nimbus' ask (1M/mo x 3 months at $0.00045), 5% works out to ~$6750 which is fine.
- Alternatively, fixed 75k-gen + 150k-embed tokens (counts separately) for 45 days. Credits expire and cannot be refunded.
- Credits may be applied to both generation and embeddings but will burn from the pool according to the respective token billing rates.

Approval routing & commercial terms:
- We require a signed MPA and a PO before applying launch incentive credits.
- Launch incentive: up to 10% of Q1 committed spend (as promo credit) — Finance will approve up to 10% for named strategic pilots only. Anything above 10% requires CRO sign-off.
- Payment terms: monthly invoicing, Net30. Failure to pay voids future credits.

Operational notes for Sales (Ben / Marissa):
- On the proposal call, ask for expected peak L30 and steady-state monthly tokens; encourage them to commit to a 3-month ramp plan (gives us guardrails for cache/batching recommendations).
- Use the usage_band_matrix.xlsx to show cost delta across tiers (attach).

I'll approve the following concrete proposal to send to Nimbus:
- Pilot: $5k pilot credit (applies to gen & embed) valid 45 days post-MPA.
- Committed pricing: Tier B pricing at $0.00045/gen for 1M–5M (12-month term). Embeddings at $0.000225/embed.
- Launch incentive: 7.5% Q1 credit applied after first paid invoice (since this is a mid-sized strategic account, falls under Finance auto-approve).

Marissa/Ben — if you think we need to sweeten with extra short-term support hours or an onboarding credit, propose now and I'll weigh the commercial impact.

-Markus
Head of Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi Olivia — appreciate the clear ask and timeline. Per internal approvals, here is our formal proposal for Nimbus' pilot + commit:

1) Pilot (PO + signed MPA required to unlock):
   - Sponsor credit: $5,000 applied as platform credit (valid 45 days from MPA signature). Can be used for both generation and embeddings; applies against invoices at the respective token rates. Credits are non-transferable and expire.

2) Committed Pricing (12-month term, monthly usage invoiced):
   - Tier A: 0–1M gen tokens/month — $0.00060/gen (list)
   - Tier B: 1M–5M gen tokens/month — $0.00045/gen (25% discount)
   - Tier C: >5M gen tokens/month — $0.00036/gen (40% discount; requires explicit CRO sign-off)
   - Embeddings: billed at 50% of gen list (examples above reflect negotiated embedding rates under commit).

3) Launch incentive: 7.5% of first-quarter committed spend applied as one-time credit after first paid invoice.

4) Commercial mechanics: signed MPA + PO required to start pilot credits and commit pricing. Monthly invoices, Net30. Credits are applied to invoices and cannot be returned as cash.

Next steps:
- If that looks reasonable, I can send a DocuSign with the MPA stub + a one-page order form (term sheet) for the 12-month commit and pilot credit. Please confirm expected monthly token target and desired start date for the pilot (you mentioned early June).

Thanks — happy to hop back on a quick call to walk procurement through the mechanics.

Best,
